name: Hierarchical Marching Cubes Enumeration
definition: A recursive octree traversal algorithm that enumerates voxel faces, edges, and vertices to extract isosurface meshes, delegating to a standard Marching Cubes routine at leaf nodes.
summary: Hierarchical Marching Cubes Enumeration is a recursive octree traversal algorithm that extracts isosurface meshes by separating traversal logic into specialized functions for faces, edges, and vertices to ensure coherent mesh generation across hierarchical boundaries.
